title: Genres borrowed by both Leeds and Osaka members
statementMd:
List genres that have been borrowed by members living in Leeds and also by members living in Osaka.

Expected columns: `genre`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT b.genre FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.id = l.member_id JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id WHERE m.city = 'Leeds' INTERSECT SELECT b.genre FROM loans l JOIN members m ON m.id = l.member_id JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id WHERE m.city = 'Osaka';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
